item.title: Which chapter should you choose first in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4?
item.description: Once you've completed the tutorial and the first page of orders, you'll be asked to choose one of three DMZ chapters in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . The game tells you that the ones you don't choose will be available to you later on, so you're not locked out of them entirely, but it does mean you should prioritize the chapter that will offer you the best rewards.

item.title: How to get and use fulton drop markers in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: Fulton drop markers in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode are essentially portable exfil points. They're categorized as ultra loot though, which is the rarest tier in the game, making them extremely hard to get your hands on. Some players have them early, however, thanks to the deluxe edition of the game granting them via a survival starter kit.

item.title: How to place a transmitter on top of two radio towers in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: One early Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ mission asks you to place a transmitter on top of two radio towers , for the "Triangulation" order during the first part of the "Underground" chapter. This is as far from underground as you can get though, because you need to scale two radio towers to complete this objective.

item.title: 15 Years Later, J.J. Abrams' Near-Perfect Sci-Fi Thriller Is Officially Back on Streaming
item.description: Kyle Chandler has had a major year. After building a career with roles in shows like Friday Night Lights and movies like Carol , Chandler has become one of the most solid on-screen presences. This year, he starred in HBO’s widely praised Lanterns , expanding the DC universe and delivering the definitive live-action take on Hal Jordan. It also delivered another great instance of Chandler as a reluctant father figure.

item.title: 25 Years Later, GTA 3 Is Still the Most Fascinating Open-World Experiment
item.description: The artwork’s nothing to write home about, just a collage of pictures in red, blue, and green hues, featuring obscure faces, a police chopper, and a car up in flames. Your instinct is to just go with your gut; Silent Hill 2 is what you came here for, after all. But something’s telling you otherwise. Maybe it’s the store clerk going on about its open-world premise, or the name itself that strikes a chord within you. Whatever reason incites it, you make the ultimate decision. Little did you know, you’d be walking home with one of the greatest achievements in video game history.

item.title: Starfighter Officially Broke a Star Wars Franchise Record Already
item.description: Though Disney's and Lucasfilm's Star Wars: Starfighter isn't out until May 27, it's already making waves. As Forbes reports, the upcoming sci-fi film is proving costly, having racked up $226.5 million by the time filming wrapped.

item.title: Vinland Saga Creator Gives a Heartbreaking Update on the Anime's Third Season
item.description: Vinland Saga is one of the most critically acclaimed manga series of all time. Author Makoto Yukimura carefully brought to life a somber reflection on war and violence through the cast of compelling characters who populate this historical drama. Vinland Saga was adapted into an anime by Wit Studio in 2019. A second season, produced by MAPPA, aired in 2023. Since then, fans have been eagerly awaiting news of a continuation, but a sad update was just shared by Yukimura himself.
